response.sql: WITH by_status AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(NULLIF(oe.fillcount, 0)) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderflow) SELECT status, average_filled_quantity, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions FROM by_status

assumptions.assumption: Executions with zero or missing fillcount are excluded from the average but included in execution counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude executions with zero or missing fillcount from both the average and the counts.
alternatives.sql: WITH by_status AS (SELECT o.orderflow AS status, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) AS execution_count FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault WHERE oe.fillcount <> 0 GROUP BY o.orderflow) SELECT status, average_filled_quantity, execution_count, execution_count::numeric / SUM(execution_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_executions FROM by_status
